data.text: Glad we could all meet before heading out. My family taught me to fish this lake, and I want it supporting our village for years to come. With 100 tons in the lake, we can each catch 10 tons this month and leave 50 to double back to 100. That’s $10,000 apiece, and we can keep doing it each month if we stick together. I’ll commit to that limit and sharing my catch honestly. Would everyone agree to the same? John, what do you think?
